title: Daily Signal Brief No. 014 — Greenhouse takes Stratum's verbal lane; EU AI Act consultation extended 30 days
summary: Three signals, two of them L3 Action. Signal 01: Greenhouse shipped six new AI capabilities Wednesday 6/10 under the framing 'built to strengthen structured hiring, not shortcut it' — the verbal lane Stratum has held for ten weeks, now spoken from a 98%-G2 incumbent (Analytics Chart Agent GA June, Job Kickoff Agent and Candidate Insights Agent Q3, MCP customer rollout now); differentiation moves from words to audit trail. Eglin recommends Compass + Forge lift the tool-surface comparison brief to inside 7 days and add a third axis (Stratum published eval set vs. Greenhouse 'structured hiring' claim with no published methodology). Signal 02: the European Commission extended the Article 6 / Annex III draft-guidelines consultation deadline from 6/23 to 7/23 in response to industry requests — Stratum's internal EOD-Friday-today file/do-not-file deadline should re-anchor to 7/16 (T-7 from new EC close), giving Forge + Kernel a working week instead of a sprint. Compact decision needed by Monday. Signal 03 (L2): the FCC's only live AI-preemption language is inside WT Docket 25-276 (Build America cell-tower NPRM) scoped to wireless-provider AI use, not employment-AI; this is meaningfully narrower than the December EO signaled, and the state-law compliance-pressure runway Compass uses extends further. Yesterday's open FCC question closes today with a more durable read. Brief at /intel/eglin/daily/2026-06-12.html.
